entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕词头残形近 Abatido abatenido：沮丧的、颓丧的；气馁低落的
entries.en: damaged headword; prob. 'abatido': dejected, downcast, dispirited
entries.notes: 西语词头带[残]且首部缺损，汉字/官话栏空；据第2条同形词头推定为 abatido 之残形。

entries.zh: 沮丧的、颓丧的；气馁低落的（人）
entries.en: dejected, downcast, dispirited
entries.notes: abatenido 系 abatido 之 17 世纪别写；本页为无汉字补编版式，汉字/官话栏均空，释义依西语词头语义推定。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕词头拼写可疑（Abatereno，或为 Abatir… 之类残句），余三栏皆空
entries.en: undecidable; headword spelling doubtful (possibly a fragment of 'Abatir…'), other columns all empty
entries.notes: 仅存可疑西语词头，闽南语/汉字/官话栏均空，语义无从互证。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕词头读法不明：疑为 avasallar（压倒、征服、压制）或 abaxar＋hallar（向下寻得）
entries.en: undecidable; prob. 'avasallar': to subdue, overwhelm; or 'abaxar hallar': to find below
entries.notes: 词头 Abas hallar 分词方式可疑，无汉字/官话栏可证，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕词头读法不明：疑为 avasallar（压倒、征服、压制）或 abaxar＋hallar（向下寻得）
entries.en: undecidable; prob. 'avasallar': to subdue, overwhelm; or 'abaxar hallar': to find below
entries.notes: 与第4条同词头而音写栏另起一读，仍无法与汉字/官话互证。

entries.zh: 调低、缓和；调节而使之低缓（如火候、语气）
entries.en: to lower by tempering; to moderate, temper

entries.zh: 压低、贬抑（使之屈辱谦卑）；羞辱
entries.en: to abase, humiliate; to cast down by humbling

entries.zh: 使之如此低落；照此压低
entries.en: to cast down thus; to abate likewise

entries.zh: 使之如此低落；照此压低
entries.en: to cast down thus; to abate likewise

entries.zh: 使之如此低落；照此压低
entries.en: to cast down thus; to abate likewise

entries.zh: 贬损、损抑（压低而加害）；贬斥伤人
entries.en: to cast down so as to harm; to belittle with injury

entries.zh: 如此贬抑（使人屈辱低首）；照样羞辱压低
entries.en: to abase in this way by humbling

entries.zh: 压制、紧压；逼迫、催逼
entries.en: to press down by squeezing; to oppress, put pressure on

entries.zh: 欺压；加重压迫、凌迫
entries.en: to oppress, bear down on; to aggravate by casting down

entries.zh: 欺负、看轻；轻蔑作贱
entries.en: to scorn, belittle; to treat with contempt

entries.zh: 欺哄、诓骗；骗压
entries.en: to deceive, cheat; to cast down by deceit

entries.zh: 压服、折服；使屈服臣服
entries.en: to subdue, bring under; to subject
entries.notes: suhetando 系 sujetando（使臣服）之 17 世纪拼法。

entries.zh: 削减、减去；夺去一物而使之低落贬损
entries.en: to diminish by taking something away; to abate, deduct

entries.zh: 大大自卑、甚为沮丧；深深折节
entries.en: to humble oneself greatly; to be deeply dejected

entries.zh: 如此自卑；这样自贬
entries.en: to abase oneself thus; to debase oneself so

entries.zh: 如此自卑；这样自贬（与上条同义异读）
entries.en: to abase oneself thus; to debase oneself so
entries.notes: Abatise 系 Abatirse 之笔误（r/s 互换）。

entries.zh: 谦卑自抑、自我贬抑；折节自屈
entries.en: to humble oneself; to debase oneself

entries.zh: 沮丧之人、颓丧的人；落魄潦倒者
entries.en: a dejected, downcast man

entries.zh: 谦卑、自卑；沮丧颓丧之情
entries.en: abasement, humility; dejection, low spirits
entries.notes: Abumiento 依全页 abat- 词族语境推定为 abatimiento 之别写；四音节音写栏与谦抑类语义相容。
